queries:
SELECT death_country,
       AVG(points_won) AS avg_points_won,
       AVG(points_won) - (SELECT AVG(avg_pw) FROM (
           SELECT AVG(pav2.points_won) AS avg_pw
           FROM player_award_vote pav2
           JOIN player p2 ON pav2.player_id = p2.player_id
           WHERE p2.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p2.death_country <> ''
           GROUP BY p2.death_country
       )) AS diff_from_mean
FROM (
    SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, pav.points_won AS points_won
    FROM player_award_vote pav
    JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> ''
)
GROUP BY death_country;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT award_id, AVG(points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote
  GROUP BY award_id
)
SELECT award_id,
       avg_points - (SUM(avg_points) OVER () - avg_points) / (COUNT(*) OVER () - 1) AS difference
FROM g;
WITH v AS (
  SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote
),
g AS (
  SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean
FROM g
